##: Uses the standalone Windows x64 executable; the companion browser extension is a separate release asset.
description: Local-first Windows privacy and OSINT scanner for personal exposure audits, with a companion Firefox-based browser extension.
notes: The companion extension must be loaded separately from the stalker-search-companion-v1.zip release asset in Firefox/LibreWolf. Scans submit queries to public search and data sources; use only for personal self-audits or other authorized checks. Settings are stored in %USERPROFILE%\.stalker-search.
